commentaire: Piotr PRZYDZIAL (Pol) actually won Stage 2a of the Szlakiem Grodow Piastowskich, and took the lead of the General Classification, but was not taken into account for the official rankings, since he was still suspended with a 1-year ban, after a positive test for EPO in the Course de la Paix 2002. Therefore, no CQ-points are awarded for him.
titre: Szlakiem Grodow Piastowskich, Stage 2a : Polkowice I.T.T. (30 km)
